Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 30 days of purchase.
Exchanges are free when a different size is needed, as long as the shoes are unworn.
Our warranty covers manufacturing defects such as sole separation for one year.
Orders ship within two business days and usually arrive in five days.
Hand wash with mild soap and leave to air dry, away from direct heat.
Gift cards never expire and can be used on any order online.
Bring worn-out pairs to any store and we will recycle them at no cost.
